name: Mustang .357 Revolver
summary: Heavy-caliber six-shot double-action revolver delivering massive terminal velocity and armor penetration at close to medium ranges.
description: The Mustang .357 is a classic American powerhouse inspired by the Colt Python and Smith & Wesson 686. Featuring a ventilated rib barrel and polished chrome or blued steel finishes, this sidearm can incapacitate hostiles with single center-mass hits and pierce unarmored vehicle engine blocks.
